title: B1 Level Final Exam
description: Test your knowledge of Past Perfect Continuous, Future Perfect Continuous, Mixed Conditionals, Passive with modals, Inversion, Participle clauses, Ellipsis, Subjunctive, Perfect infinitive/gerund, Complex conjunctions, Modal verbs in the past, Causative, Emphatic structures, Concessive clauses, Future in the past, Preferences, Phrasal verbs

exercises.instruction: Fill in the past perfect continuous form.

items.sentence: She ___ (work) for 20 years when she retired.
The ground was wet because it ___ (rain) all night.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the future perfect continuous form.

items.sentence: By next month, I ___ (work) here for 10 years.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the mixed conditional forms.

items.sentence: If I ___ (study) harder at university, I ___ (have) a better job now.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the passive form with the modal.

items.sentence: If I had known, I would have come. → Had ___
items.correct: I known, I would have come

exercises.instruction: Rewrite the sentence using a participle clause.

items.sentence: While I was walking down the street, I met an old friend. → ___ down the street, I met an old friend.

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentence using the subjunctive form.
Fill in the perfect infinitive or perfect gerund.

items.sentence: You can go out ___ you finish your homework.
I won't go ___ you come with me.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct modal + have + V3.
Fill in the causative form (have/get something done).
Rewrite the sentence using the emphatic structure.

items.correct: What I need is a long holiday.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct phrasal verb.

items.sentence: I can't ___ up with this noise.

items.target: I have been working here for 10 years.

items.source: Если бы я знал, я бы пришёл.
items.target: Had I known, I would have come.
I suggest that she be present.

items.source: Я не могу мириться с этим шумом.
items.target: I can't put up with this noise.
